question: Estimate the annual market size of online travel booking (OTA) in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Bookings GMV or net revenue? GMV.
Include only domestic or also outbound international? Both, originating from India.
Include hotels, flights, trains (IRCTC), buses, holiday packages? All categories.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up by category: flights + hotels + trains + buses + packages.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Domestic flight passengers India FY26: ~170M (15% YoY growth from 153M in FY24); avg ticket ~₹5,500. Online booking share: ~85%. Online flight GMV: 170M × 5,500 × 0.85 = ~₹80,000 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Hotels: ~150M room-nights booked online (domestic + international); avg ₹2,500/night = ₹37,500 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bus tickets (RedBus etc.): ~250M tickets online; avg ₹500 = ₹12,500 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~170M (15% YoY growth from 153M in FY24); avg ticket ~₹5,500. Online booking share: ~85%. Online flight GMV: 170M × 5,500 × 0.85 = ~₹80,000 Cr.
~30M passengers; avg ₹40,000; online share ~80%. International GMV: ~₹96,000 Cr.
~150M room-nights booked online (domestic + international); avg ₹2,500/night = ₹37,500 Cr.
~85% of train tickets booked online; ~600M tickets/year; avg fare ₹350 = ~₹21,000 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Holiday packages (MMT, Yatra, Thomas Cook online)

calculationFlow: Domestic flight passengers India FY26: ~170M (15% YoY growth from 153M in FY24); avg ticket ~₹5,500. Online booking share: ~85%. Online flight GMV: 170M × 5,500 × 0.85 = ~₹80,000 Cr.
International flights from India: ~30M passengers; avg ₹40,000; online share ~80%. International GMV: ~₹96,000 Cr.
Hotels: ~150M room-nights booked online (domestic + international); avg ₹2,500/night = ₹37,500 Cr.
Train (IRCTC) bookings: ~85% of train tickets booked online; ~600M tickets/year; avg fare ₹350 = ~₹21,000 Cr.
Bus tickets (RedBus etc.): ~250M tickets online; avg ₹500 = ₹12,500 Cr.
Holiday packages (MMT, Yatra, Thomas Cook online): ~₹15,000 Cr.
